title: NCAA: Salvador the hero as Jose Rizal U escapes Mapua in thriller
summary: Sean Salvador was the hero as Jose Rizal University escaped Mapua University, 65-64, in a thriller to start its campaign in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Monday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
